speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a chronic wound on your right lower leg; could you tell me how long it has been there and if it is getting larger or infected?

To better understand the severity, would you mind describing the appearance of the wound and any pain you are experiencing?

speaker: Patient
text: 57-year-old male. The patient reports a large wound on his right lower leg that has been present for 6 months. He mentions that his legs have been chronically swollen for over 10 years and that his mother and brother had similar leg problems. He had a documented deep vein thrombosis (DVT) in the affected leg 5 years ago but has no other significant past medical history.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Large wound on the right lower leg. I also have Chronic leg swelling, Family history of similar leg problems.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Deep vein thrombosis in the right leg 5 years prior. No other significant medical history. Social history: Non-smoker, drinks alcohol socially. Works as an accountant.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, recent injuries, heart disease, or diabetes. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the information. Since you deny diabetes and recent injuries, can you tell me what activities or footwear might be causing pressure on your right lower leg, and does the wound have any redness, warmth, or drainage?
